Note to Entry no 1: The Company on December 27, 2024 had informed the stock exchange that it was in process of incorporating a new subsidiary company by subscribing and acquiring 80% Equity Shares of the said new subsidiary company and on January 08, 2025 the Ministry of Corporate Affairs has approved incorporation of Morepen Medtech Limited (at present Morepen Medipath Limited).
Note to Entry no 2: The Company on February 19, 2025 had informed the stock exchange that Dr. Morepen Limited (DML), a wholly owned subsidiary of the company, has approved the formation of a new subsidiary company in the name of Quick Med Private Limited (Quick Med) and through DML the Company will indirectly hold 80% of the Equity shares/Voting Rights in Quick Med and on March 20, 2025 the Ministry of Corporate Affairs has approved incorporation of Quick Med.
Further, The Company on March 31, 2025 had informed the stock exchange that effective from the end of date the change in status of DML from Wholly Owned Subsidiary to Subsidiary of the Company and that the holding of the Company in DML reduced to 80%.
Accordingly, the Aggregate holding (% shares or voting rights) as at the end of the quarter is as follows:
A) The Company holds 80% of the Equity shares/Voting Rights in DML; B) DML holds 80% of the Equity shares/Voting Rights in Quick Med.
